comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into probe, harness, three candidate implementations, audits, judges, promote, reviews, fixes, and final gate.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept ownership in one trajectory and moved directly from probing to writing /output modules and entry.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had many owned stages but required several joins and later promotion; serial had one owner for implementation, integration, verification, and delivery.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel never reached candidate selection, promotion, or final result lifecycle; serial closed the loop from write to verification to final answer.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a coherent /output tree with test11.mjs and seven local library files.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full 2399-second agent budget, returned code 143, and workflow state shows repeated stalled implementation retries.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed in 626 seconds with return code 0 and had 1772 seconds remaining in the cell budget.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed by timeout before deliverable promotion; serial closed normally with substantial remaining budget and a passing artifact.

outcome_analysis.explanation: This is a serial-only pass. Parallel did not fail because the task was impossible or because the prompt differed; it failed because its multi-agent workflow spent the finite run on broad probe/harness work, three candidate implementations, and repeated stalled implementation retries, then was killed before promotion. The official artifact was empty, so the evaluator had no test11.mjs to run. Serial completed the same obligation by writing the modules and entry to /output, verifying them, and passing 202/202.
parallel_contributors: Broad workflow fan-out and stalled implementation retries consumed the run budget before promote/final phases.
No implementation reached /output/test11.mjs, so artifact validation found no files.
serial_contributors: Single-agent ownership carried probing, implementation, integration, and verification through to /output.
Serial verified differential behavior and delivered the expected entry and local library files.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial implemented a pragmatic subset of Python argparse and schedule behavior sufficient for the evaluator; parallel never produced a comparable final implementation to inspect.
